description: PDF viewer for the Cardputer Zero

store.summary: Read PDF files on your Cardputer Zero, with zoom, search and a text mode
store.description:
Pick a PDF from your folders or recent files and read it on the Cardputer.

What it can do:
- Fit to width or show the whole page, zoom in and out, rotate
- Scroll straight from one page into the next
- Text mode: the words of the page wrapped to fit the screen, in any size
- Search the whole document, with matches marked on the page
- Contents list from the PDF's outline, go to any page
- Night colours
- Opens password protected files
- Remembers the page you were on in every file
- Uses the whole 2.8in EXT display if you have DisplayMOD, and the built-in screen keeps its own full view

F X Z C work as the arrows printed on them and L M as Page Up and Down, no Fn needed. Press Fn+H on any screen for the keys.

Copy PDFs over with Airfiles, SFTP or a USB stick.
